narrative: High cabinet temperature alarm on CES40-2441D-0209. Opened the cabinet and found the filters completely blocked, no meaningful airflow through them at all. Replaced the filter set and vacuumed the plenum. Cabinet temperature came back down to normal within about twenty five minutes of restoring airflow. Checked the fan bank while I was in there, all six running at full speed. This unit sits at the end of the row nearest the access track, which is likely why it loads its filters faster than its neighbours. Recommend a shorter filter interval on this position.
